industries.label: Technology / Software
industries.blurb: The largest single destination for MSBA graduates — roughly a third of recent peer-program classes, and typically the highest-paying.

industries.label: Financial Services & Fintech
industries.blurb: Consistently the #1 or #2 destination in peer-program reporting.

roles.why: The industry's structural, non-discretionary analytics need
Credit scoring, propensity, pricing, collections

FP&A, treasury, portfolio and investment analytics

industries.label: Consulting
industries.blurb: Roughly a tenth to a fifth of recent peer-program classes; lower starting comp, faster exposure breadth.

roles.why: The core hire
